title: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance Bank 2
shortDescription: PCM detected: exhaust valve control solenoid bank 2 range/performance.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates exhaust valve control solenoid bank 2 range/performance. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Vehicle is generally safe to drive short distances, but performance and emissions are affected.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect Secondary pump wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect Secondary pump part and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.

safetyImpact: Vehicle is generally safe to drive short distances, but performance and emissions are affected.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect PCM relay wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect PCM relay part and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.
